name: read_file
description: Reads and returns the content of a specified text file. Use a line or regular-expression range when only part of the file is needed.

file_path.description: The path to the text file to read.

start_line.description: Optional start boundary. A positive 1-based line number in line mode, or a non-empty JavaScript RegExp pattern in regex mode.

end_line.description: Optional inclusive end boundary. A positive 1-based line number in line mode, or a non-empty JavaScript RegExp pattern in regex mode.

read_mode.description: How to interpret start_line and end_line. Defaults to line.

show_line_numbers.description: Whether to prefix returned content lines with their original 1-based line number. Defaults to false.
